name: A Night with a Bat Girl
source:
A Night With A Bat Girl is a short game with a large number of branching paths and endings about a bat girl named Dreamscape who's looking for somewhere to spend the night when she ends up at your bedroom window.

[From [url=https://furrgroup.itch.io/a-night-with-a-bat-girl]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《与蝙蝠女孩共度一夜》是一款短篇游戏，有大量分支路径和结局，讲述了一位名叫Dreamscape的蝙蝠女孩正在寻找过夜的地方，最后却出现在你卧室的窗前。

[来自[url=https://furrgroup.itch.io/a-night-with-a-bat-girl]Itch.io[/url]]
